description: Source code for RemindersService class handling reminders via EventKit, including listing and adding reminders, with permission checks and list resolution.

classes.name: RemindersService
classes.description: Final class implementing RemindersServicing protocol, providing methods to list and add reminders.

methods.name: list

methods.name: add

methods.name: resolveList
methods.description: Private static method to resolve a reminder list (calendar) by ID or name, with fallback to default.
